citation: Atkinson FS, Heruc GA, Tan VMH, et al. Extending the Overnight Fast: Sex Differences in Acute Metabolic Responses to Breakfast. Nutrients. 2020.
protocol: Overnight fasts of 12, 14 and 16 h (each repeated three times per person) ending in a standard breakfast with 75 g available carbohydrate; standard evening meal at 19:00 (55/15/30 % E); glucose and insulin for 120 min
population: n=24 healthy adults (sex split in Tables 1 and 2), age 23.0+/-2.6 y, BMI 22.1+/-2.5; University students

reports.where: Table 1 (F) and Table 2 (M): fasting, 2 h, iAUC by fast length

note: Directly exercises the prefast_hours input (12/14/16 h). SEs in the tables are model-estimated and identical across columns. Ad libitum intake after breakfast also reported.
